seo.title: German B2 Course in Dehradun | Goethe-Zertifikat B2 | Language Zone
seo.description: German B2 (Upper intermediate) course in Dehradun. Join discussions and write formal, detailed texts. Online and offline batches at Language Zone.

tagline: Work and study in German with confidence
outcomes: Interact fluently and spontaneously with native speakers
Understand complex texts on concrete and abstract topics
Write clear, detailed texts and formal letters
Explain a viewpoint and weigh up advantages and disadvantages
Follow lectures and news without much effort
suits: Applicants to German-taught programmes (requirements differ, so check your university)
Professionals who work in German-speaking teams

skills.writing: Write detailed texts and formal letters
skills.speaking: Argue a position and take part in discussion

faq.q: Is B2 enough for university in Germany?
faq.a: It depends on the university and the programme. Many German-taught programmes ask for B2 or C1 proof. Check the admissions page of your target university.

faq.q: What changes between B1 and B2?
faq.a: You move from handling situations to arguing, explaining and writing in a formal register.

faq.q: Can I prepare for the exam and keep working?
faq.a: Yes. We offer evening batches and personalised sessions, so you can prepare alongside your job.
